title: SOE Estimator (Energy Counting)
text: State of energy estimator with energy counting, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Specify Current input as cell current(s)} sets the option to specify current input port, {Nominal cell energy capacity, Enom, (W*Hr)} sets the nominal energy capacity of cell and {Algorithm data type} sets the option to choose data type for block algorithm. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: InitialSOE
ports.summary: Initial state of energy, unitless scalar | vector

ports.name: SOE
ports.summary: Battery state of energy scalar | vector

params.name: Specify Current input as cell current(s)
params.values: Option to specify current input port as vector off (default) | on

params.name: Nominal cell energy capacity, Enom, (W*Hr)
params.values: Nominal energy capacity of cell 113.1300 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Algorithm data type
params.values: Option to choose data type for block algorithm Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
